title: Pill tabs
description: Default section tabs for pages with 5+ sections or sections with icons (settings-like pages): no track, h30 round pills with 16px icons and 12px/600 labels, and one item-hover pill that slides to the active tab in 300ms ease-out.
when: 5+ sections of one page, or sections with icons (Cấu hình: Hộp thư, Nhóm thư, Nguồn khách, Mặt hàng, Mẫu thư, Data Hub, Doanh nghiệp, Người dùng).
Section switching that needs URL state (?tab=) or an unsaved-changes guard (onBeforeChange).

instead.need: 2–5 filter values shown in full, often with counts
2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page
Filters of a list (status, owner, date)
Sections of one record inside a card or dialog

a11y: WAI-ARIA tablist / tab / tabpanel with id, aria-controls and aria-labelledby; roving tabindex; ←/→, Home and End.
activation="manual" moves focus with arrows and switches on Enter or Space; default "automatic" switches button tabs on arrow keys once onBeforeChange approves.
Overflowing rows scroll sideways with no scrollbar, keep the active tab in view and show a 2px edge cue; sliding and fades turn off under prefers-reduced-motion.
notes: Keep the section in the URL with `const [tab, setTab] = useTabParam("mail", { values })` (or `useFilterParams().setParams({ tab }, "replace")`): arrow keys replace the entry so they never stack history entries.
Pass `idPrefix` when the page renders its own `role="tabpanel"` below (`${idPrefix}-panel` labelled by `${idPrefix}-tab-${key}`).

When to use which: PillTabs for 5+ sections or sections with icons · SegmentedControl for 2–5 filter values shown in full with counts · TextTabs for 2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page · FilterChipRow for filters.
